title: Eversense CGM
body: I don't get any data when connceting the Eversense to xDrip, can anybody solve this problem?

comments.body:
Which version of ESEL do you use?
The traditional one: Did you make sure your phone is not only rooted but also has sqlite3 installed?

The new one that does not need root: Did you patch the Eversens app on your own or get the apk from somewhere?

Hey thanks for your fast response. I am using the newest Eversense XL for 7 days now. I did not know that I have to patch the Eversense App, since I did not find anything about how to set it up, so I just used the newest xDrip Apk and the latest version of Eversense CGM from the PlayStore. How can I get that patched Eversense App?

You do need the companion app "ESEL": https://github.com/AdrianLxM/Esel/

At the moment you do have to build it for yourself. As up until recently you had to be quite tech-savvy anyway (flash another operating system onto the phone) this was the way to go.

We are working on a more user-friendly option now that you don't have to root the phone anymore.

There is an easier solution availabe as well:
https://github.com/BernhardRo/Esel/tree/master/apk
This does not require a rooted phone and no compiling...

@xLevelster: Can you provide some informations regarding the system itself? How long does the battery of the transmitter last? Is it easy to remove it (for snorkeling/diving) and attach again? How accurate is it? What  happens when you don't calibrate twice a day?

Battery lasts up to 36 hours. It is very easy to remove because it is just sticked to your skin with an adhesive. For me it is super accurate. You won't get any readings after 2 hours when you don't calibrate.

Yes, the battery lasts for about 36h, but it takes only roughly 10 min to reload it. Therefore it is no problem to easily take it off every day (e.g. before taking a shower) and reload it. For me, this is even an advantage as my skin had problems with the 14 days of wearing a freestyle libre. With eversense my skin gets a break and a new plaster every day and with this I have no problems at all.
In terms of accuracy: the values are somehow noisy, but accurate.
Can you fix it without a plaster with armband or 3d printed holder?

> Can you fix it without a plaster with armband or 3d printed holder?

Yes not really necessary but that should work, depending on how good it stays over the sensor.
I ask because I have to remove it on some days more than once when I go diving...
